text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — Sycamore Payments submitted a request to onboard a POS transaction reranker. They need inference for reranking top-10 candidates returned by their search with strict latency target ~60ms p99 per user request (avg ~90 tokens). They want hosted first, may move to Dedicated if throughput >5k qps.

jules_sycamore: thanks Maria — correct. also must not log PANs or full card numbers; we will pass masked tokens but want an explicit PII/PII-safety check. Pilot target in 3 weeks.

ash_solutions: @jules_sycamore got it. quick q: do you have sample payloads + golden labels for reranker eval? we'll need ~2k annotated pairs to run offline uplift/regression tests.

jules_sycamore: sending sample payloads via SFTP tonight. labels are rough; can we start with 200 warmup examples while we finalize labelling?

devon_sre: note on latency — 60ms p99 is tight on hosted for reranking since that's often 8–10 model calls per request. Recommend batching on the client and a lighter 7B candidate-scoring model (quantized). @ash_solutions can propose perf profiles.

ash_solutions: Agreed. Plan: run microbenchmarks with q8_0 quantization on a 7B candidate-scoring checkpoint. If hosted can't meet SLO we'll propose Dedicated with reserved 2xA10G pool. Also enable prefix-KV caching and request-level batching.

maria_cs: Risk note: renewal impact — if pilot succeeds they could commit to Dedicated annual capacity; if latency or privacy issues stall, upsell probability drops. Mark as high-priority onboarding.

ira_security: FYI security review: need to confirm ingestion pipeline strips full PANs and that customer opts into log-redact. Also require a Data Processing Addendum before any private deployment. I'll own the security checklist.

ash_solutions: action items:
1) run offline evaluation (200 seed now + 2k when available) — @ash_solutions (ETA 3 days)
2) run perf microbenchmarks on 7B q8_0 (devon_sre + ash) — ETA 4 days
3) confirm SFTP samples received + redaction status (jules_sycamore) — ETA 24h
4) security checklist & DPA (ira_security) — ETA 5 days
5) schedule enablement call + demo (maria_cs) — propose Tue 11am PT

jules_sycamore: confirmed SFTP upload started. I'll ping when labels arrive. Tue 11am PT works.

devon_sre: quick perf command we'll run locally:
```
./perf_runner --model ./weights/7b-q8 --batch-size 8 --seq-len 90 --warmup 200 --measure p99
```

ash_solutions: also adding eval metrics: NDCG@10 and per-merchant-category fairness checks. If NDCG uplift < 0.05 we won't push to production.

maria_cs: thanks — I'll draft a short enablement doc and add to the customer tracker. tagging @account-team for visibility :eyes:

ira_security: added security checklist items here. @ash_solutions pls share the logging-redaction config so we can sign DPA.

ash_solutions: will drop config snippet once perf run completes. moving to in-progress.

maria_cs: last note — please flag blockers here. otherwise reconvene after perf + offline eval.

jules_sycamore: thanks all :thumbsup:
